systems.notes: Separate radial cowling volume with spinner interface; not a uniform cylinder shared with fuselage.
Lofted from longitudinal station cage profiles; must beat cylindrical blockout silhouette.
Tapered planform with root thickness greater than tip; left/right continuous or mirrored pair under one system object.
Horizontal and vertical stabilizers with tapered chords; not a single slab slab-tail.
Two-seat canopy with bow/rail language; open-rear gunner configuration legible; no cube glass.
Nose and main gear with strut/wheel separation; must be visible in wing-root gear framing camera.
Spinner plus blades sized to propeller diameter authority.
Aileron, elevator, and rudder volumes as separately named meshes parented or co-exported with the system.

forbidden_construction: single GEO_Airframe cylinder reused as cowling+fuselage
toy-scale gear or propeller that fails silhouette landmarks
